stock.description: Ganfeng Lithium Co., Limited stands as a leading international producer and distributor of a comprehensive range of lithium-based materials. The company operates extensively throughout Mainland China, the broader Asian region, the European Union, North America, and other global markets. Its operations are structured around three principal segments: Lithium Metal and Compounds, Lithium Batteries, and Lithium Ore Resources and Other ventures. The firm holds substantial stakes in key lithium resource ventures globally, including Australia's Mount Marion and Pilbara Pilgangoora mines, the Cauchari-Olaroz and Mariana projects located in Argentina, the Sonora project in Mexico, China's Ningdu Heyuan mine and Qinghai Yiliping lithium salt lake project, the Avalonia project in Ireland, and the Goulamina spodumene ore project in Mali, Africa. Ganfeng Lithium's product portfolio spans a broad spectrum of lithium compounds, such as battery-grade lithium hydroxide, lithium carbonate, lithium chloride, butyl lithium, and lithium fluoride. It also supplies lithium metals configured as ingots, foils, rods, particles, and customized alloy powders like copper-lithium or lithium-aluminum. Furthermore, the firm develops and furnishes polymer lithium batteries, in addition to sophisticated lithium-ion cells for electric vehicles, industrial energy storage, and personal electronic devices. Beyond its manufacturing activities, the company is also engaged in the exploration and sale of lithium ores, complemented by robust lithium battery recycling solutions. Its high-quality lithium offerings are exported worldwide and are integral to a multitude of sectors, including the production of electric vehicles, portable electronics, chemicals, and pharmaceuticals. Ganfeng Lithium serves a client base that includes manufacturers of battery cathode materials, battery suppliers, and automotive original equipment manufacturers. Established in 2000, the company maintains its principal offices in Xinyu, China.

provenance.depreciation: Analyst EBITDA minus EBIT when nonnegative and both available; otherwise modeled TTM D&A/revenue. Analyst measure definitions are not independently certified.
provenance.riskFreeRate: User-directed USD Treasury proxy under the HKD/USD peg; not an observed HKD yield or a copied US-stock WACC
provenance.tax: TTM effective tax; scenario assumption, not a marginal-rate forecast
provenance.kd: TTM accounting interest / average reported debt; not a current financing quote
provenance.erp: 4.75% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.beta: FMP profile beta; lookback, frequency and benchmark unspecified by the response
provenance.terminalG: 2.25% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.cash: All reported cash and short-term investments assumed nonoperating; adjustable
provenance.investments: Long-term investments assumed nonoperating at book value; adjustable, not fair-value evidence
provenance.priority: Preferred and minority book values are adjustable value proxies; cost defaults to common Ke
provenance.leases: Cash-flow-matched debt reconciliation: liabilities whose payments remain in FCFF are not deducted again; financing treatment requires matching profit, depreciation and reinvestment adjustments
